professionalSummary: Lead Engineer and technical lead of a card authorisation service at a retail bank since 2022, signing design reviews for changes to the authorisation path.
Eight years of software engineering experience, including senior software engineer roles on the same service from 2017 to 2022.
Holder of the bank's secure development certification for the payments domain since 2021, renewed 2024.
Owner of the service's technical roadmap, reviewed quarterly with the head of payments engineering.
Mentor to six engineers under the engineering mentoring scheme, authoring boundary notes for each signed design review.
experienceHighlights: Technical lead of the card authorisation service, responsible for design review sign‑offs and technical roadmap ownership.
Led incident reviews for four authorisation outages over the past three years, following the payments incident review process.
Mentored six engineers, documenting design review boundaries and ensuring clarity of scope.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Signed design reviews with boundary notes (two samples).
Incident review report for a recent outage.
Certification record extract for secure development certification.
